The '''''Anodyne''''' was a medical ship in service during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], named after the medical substance [[Anodyne/Legends|anodyne]]. After being severely injured in a fight with a [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], [[Vargai Javis]] was transferred to the ''Anodyne'' for [[Kolto/Legends|kolto]] treatment.<ref name="Follow">{{TORcite|type=message|FW: Follow-up on Karrels Javis|Watcher Three}}</ref>
